root_idea.summary: A root centered on pleasant taste and the experience of delight.
root_idea.development: The lexical field extends from pleasant flavor to general pleasantness, desirability, pleasure, and derived expressions for experiencing or mutually giving pleasure. Some related forms are lexicalized in specialized uses such as sleep, wine, or a pleasant place.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form.
Displayed as the Quran-attested adjectival form لَذَّةٌ.

senses.definition: To take pleasure or delight in something; to find it pleasant.
senses.usage_conditions: Form I may take an object or occur with بِـ for finding something pleasant or delighting in it. The Quranic occurrence presents the eyes as experiencing delight.
An adjectival epithet for something experienced as agreeable or delicious; the Quranic attestations qualify drink as pleasant or delicious for those who consume it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become pleasant, delightful, delicious, or desirable.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form I use describing a thing that is pleasant or becomes so.
A distinct nominal use recorded under the same written form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pleasure or delight; pleasantness, deliciousness, lusciousness, sweetness, or enjoyment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun, with plural لَذَّاتٌ; it is contrasted with pain and is near-synonymous with شَهْوَةٌ in one sense. لَذْوَى is recorded as a variant with the same meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pleasurable, easy, comfortable eating and drinking in a state of ease and sufficiency.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use referring to the enjoyment of food and drink under comfortable and abundant circumstances.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pleasant, delightful, delicious, luscious, sweet, savoury, or desirable.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival epithet applied to such things as beverages, a cup, life, or conversation; those examples do not impose an object-class restriction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person enjoying pleasure or delight.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantivized personal description; the related plural expression refers to people who pursue their pleasures.
A lexicalized definite use, with plural forms also recorded.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give and receive pleasure mutually in sexual intercourse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal Form III construction describing mutual sexual enjoyment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become pleased or delighted; to take pleasure or delight in oneself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form V reflexive or inchoative expression of experiencing or deriving pleasure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give each other pleasure or delight in sexual intercourse.

other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form X expression of experiencing something as pleasurable.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place of pleasure or delight; a pleasant place or stretch of ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Plural مَلَاذُّ; one recorded use concerns urging a riding animal onto level, non-rugged ground.
